points.name: apps.timer.recent_register
points.interpretation: The recent-item builder registers C4FFEE0 with filter 7 and a pointer to an eight-byte duration record in user data.

points.name: apps.timer.recent_hm_unit
points.interpretation: The hour and minute branches set a translated unit on the recent-item label.

points.name: apps.timer.recent_seconds_unit
points.interpretation: The seconds-only branch sets the sec.timer translation on the recent-item label.

points.name: apps.timer.run.stop_register
points.interpretation: The run view registers C500508 on the stop control with filter 7.

points.name: apps.timer.run.toggle_register
points.interpretation: The run view registers C500814 on the start/pause control with filter 7.

points.name: apps.timer.run.stop_event_code
points.interpretation: The stop callback checks for event code 7 before executing the stop path.

points.name: apps.timer.run.toggle_event_code
points.interpretation: The toggle callback checks for event code 7 before switching the timer state.

points.name: apps.timer.done.caption
points.interpretation: The reminder creation sets the translation for end.timer on its label.

evidence: The main page creates a run view under its root and the two controls register callbacks filtered on event code 7. Both callbacks check that code before changing the timer state. Recent entries register a callback whose event user data points to a duration record. The reminder creates a label from end.timer.
scope: Only the recorded shared function call sites while their respective state or root slot is nonzero; timer backend operations and other paths are not covered.
limitations: Skipping event actions or changing user data can leave the timer, reminder, and view state inconsistent. The slots are not thread barriers; patch publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior and recovery are unverified.
